mobile.rules.blockReport: Use Block and Report on any bad partner — you can leave anytime.
mobile.safety.deleteBody: Identity lives on this device (export backup in Settings). Hub data (friends, reports) can be deleted via the web form or by emailing privacy@ruletka.me.
mobile.safety.intro: Quick tips for every call. Full guide on the web.
mobile.safety.tip1: You’re 18+ — leave if a partner looks underage or asks for money.
mobile.safety.tip2: Block and Report are always available during a live call.
mobile.safety.tip3: Partners may screenshot or record — don’t share secrets or nudes you regret.
mobile.safety.tip4: Hide IP (Settings) uses TURN relay when the hub provides it.
mobile.settings.backupHint: Kimlik + prefs dışa aktar. Yıldızlar hub’da (★ {stars}). Şifre önerilir.
mobile.settings.blockedHint: People you blocked won't match or call you. Unblock anytime.
mobile.settings.dataSaverHint: Uses lower camera resolution and frame rate to save mobile data, heat, and battery. Applies on the next camera open (or when you return to Live).
mobile.settings.importDoneDevice: Profile imported on this device. Reconnecting to the hub…
mobile.settings.legalHint: Hub sayfaları (web ile aynı). Mağaza incelemesi için gerekli.
mobile.settings.notifyComingSoon: In-app ringtone + vibration when a friend calls while the app is open. True offline push (OS notifications when the app is closed) needs a store build with Expo push — not required for normal use.
mobile.settings.notifyHint: In-app ringtone when a friend calls (app open). Offline OS alerts need push registration + hub ROULETTE_PUSH_WEBHOOK_URL.
mobile.settings.pushUnavailable: Offline push module not active in this build path.
mobile.settings.reportHistoryEmpty: No reports or blocks logged yet.
mobile.settings.reportHistoryHint: Stored only on this device. Not sent to the hub again.

mobile.settings.unblockBody: They may match or friend-request you again.
